existing.description: If you are taking courses at Summer University to qualify for admission to a master programme at CBS, you should make sure that you choose the correct courses.
eligibility: To apply for CBS Summer University as an exchange student, you must meet the following requirements:
You must be officially nominated by your home university to take courses at CBS Summer University.
To apply for CBS Summer University as an AURORA student, you must meet the following requirements:
You must be officially nominated as an AURORA student by your home university to take courses at CBS Summer University.
To apply for CBS Summer University as a credit transfer student, you must meet the following requirements:
You must be a full-time student at another Danish educational institution.
You must be an EU/EEA/Swiss citizen or have a permanent residence permit for Denmark .
To apply for Summer University as a single course student, you must meet the following requirements:
You must be an EU/EEA/Swiss citizen or have a permanent residence permit for Denmark. If you do not have one of the listed residence permits, you will need to apply as a Non-European Freemover.
You must have completed an upper secondary exam (high school).
If you are taking courses at Summer University to qualify for admission to a master programme at CBS, you should make sure that you choose the correct courses.
Please note that you can only use bachelor courses as supplementary courses for master admission.
You must have a pre-approval of credit transfer from your own educational institution. Read more about pre-approval below under Documentation.
If you do not fulfil the requirements, you must apply in another student category.
existing.eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students admitted to CBS MSc programmes. Must check scholarship box in portal and upload 2-page personal statement. ~25 awards/year across all graduate programmes. Most generous Danish package: tuition + monthly stipend. Interview may be required.

There are no tuition fees for credit transfer students as as long as you upload a pre-approval of credit transfer from your own educational institution before the application deadline.

scholarships.title: Aalborg University International Student Scholarship (tuition fee waiver and monthly stipend)

existing.description: Aalborg University grants a small number (approximately 15 per year) of tuition-fee-waiver-plus-stipend scholarships to individually selected applicants from non-EU/EEA countries applying to fee-paying master's programmes for the September intake. The award covers the full tuition fee and pays a monthly living-expense stipend of DKK 11,225 / EUR 1,503 (2026 rate) for four semesters. There is no separate application: all non-EU applicants to a master's programme are considered automatically, and decisions are communicated by the beginning of July at the latest. AAU states the scholarship may not cover all living expenses in Denmark.
eligibility: Applicant is a non-EU/EEA citizen applying to a fee-paying master's programme at Aalborg University
Does not hold one of the residence permits that exempt non-EU/EEA students from tuition and application fees
Applying to the September intake (scholarships are granted per September intake only)
Selected individually on the basis of academic qualifications and Aalborg University's strategic considerations
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants from outside the EU/EEA who apply to a fee-paying English-taught master's programme at Aalborg University for the September intake. AAU states "EU/EEA students cannot apply for scholarships at AAU" and that Aalborg University "does not offer tuition waivers or scholarships for bachelor's programmes". Around 15 scholarships are granted each year.
benefits: Possible tuition refund if the fee was paid before the scholarship decision
coverage: Full tuition fee waiver for the master's programme
Monthly living-expense stipend of DKK 11,225 / EUR 1,503 (2026 rate) for four semesters
existing.english_requirement: The scholarship attaches to English-taught master's programmes for which non-EU/EEA students pay tuition.
application_method: Automatic consideration when submitting the master's programme application
Application and application-fee receipt uploaded in the AAU application portal (dans.stads.dk)
existing.selection_notes: "Each September intake, Aalborg University grants a limited number of scholarships to individually selected applicants from non-EU/EEA countries based on strategic considerations and academic qualifications."
existing.best_fit: High-achieving non-EU/EEA applicants to AAU master's programmes who cannot fund Danish tuition fees.
existing.notes: AAU warns: "We do not advise you to rely solely on receiving a scholarship when applying for a master's degree at Aalborg University." Stipends may be paid retroactively from 1 September if a Danish CPR number, NemKono and tax registration are not in place.
existing.duration: Four semesters (the standard duration of a master's degree at AAU); no further stipend beyond the first two years of study
existing.deadline_display: There is no separate scholarship application: "All non-EU applicants are automatically considered when applying to a master's programme. Therefore, it is not possible to apply for a scholarship separately." AAU states "We will inform all applicants about the scholarship decision by the beginning of July at the latest, though it may be earlier."
existing.program_type: Government-financed tuition waiver plus stipend, awarded by the university
